text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 1 Detected evidence and position

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: W = Σwi; C = Σmatched wi / W. Q = Σmatched wi

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: exp[−½(dij/(τ/2))²] / W.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: An angular chance allowance D depends on predicted-node density

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: at each observed radius. Position P = Q − D. RMS = √mean(dij²),

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: unweighted across matched profiles.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 2 Scale preferences

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Overall + c/a: S = λ[ln(s)/ln(1.05)]² + μ[ln(r)/ln(1.05)]². Cubic fits

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: and c-insensitive HCP omit the ratio term.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Legacy independent-axis mode uses a mean squared fractional axis

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: deviation normalized to 5%. These preferences are not physical

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: strain limits; zero weights remove costs, not search bounds.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 3 Weak and missing predictions

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: At assessable unmatched predictions, weak maxima are assigned

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: locally and compared with 11 rotated controls. They contribute a

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: bounded bonus B; they do not satisfy the strong-profile screen.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Unsupported positions cost M = Σunsupported 2^[−(g/rhalf)²] /

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Nassessable. rhalf = 0 restores uniform cost. This radial falloff is

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: heuristic, not contrast-transfer correction.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 4 Rank and acceptance

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: R = P − S + ηB − ηM. Strong screen: ≥4 independent matches,

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: directional spread >0.5, C >0.30 and P >0.20. Final rank must also

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: exceed 0.20.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Assessability excludes masked, out-of-band or unresolved prediction

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: sites. Missing spots are not crystallographic extinction evidence.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Weak maxima cannot rescue a fit with too few strong profiles.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(91%,95%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 5 Auto · dominant rank

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Prepare admitted peak pool once. Try distinct minimum-strength

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: cutoffs; match crystal candidates at each. Prefer a passing result,

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: then highest top rank, then more profiles.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: The denominator changes as peaks are removed. A higher winning

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: rank can coincide with loss of a weaker second pattern. This mode

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: deliberately selects the dominant interpretation.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(91%,95%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 6 Auto · geometry (1–2 patterns)

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Search cutoff subsets using freely fitted grid evidence normalized to

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: the full admitted pool. Count shared evidence once; subtract chance

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: and per-grid costs.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: A screened second grid contributes only when it improves the

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: objective. Run crystal matching once on the selected subset.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Neither Auto mode jointly optimizes multiple crystal patterns.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(31%,39%,45%); stroke:none;
